question: The maximum consumption of an item is 80 units per day and the maximum lead time is 12 days. The Reorder Level of this item is
explanation: Reorder Level = Maximum Consumption x Maximum Lead Time = 80 x 12 = 960 units.

question: For an item, the Reorder Level is 1200 units. Normal consumption is 39 units per day and normal lead time is 15 days. The Minimum Stock Level is
explanation: Minimum Level = Reorder Level - (Normal Consumption x Normal Lead Time) = 1200 - (39 x 15) = 615 units.

question: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) is collected from bidders mainly to
options: Pay for the goods in advance
Ensure seriousness of bidders and discourage withdrawal of bids
Cover transportation costs of the buyer
Pay applicable taxes on the contract
explanation: EMD safeguards the buyer against frivolous or withdrawn bids.
